<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">APPNP restart propagation  |  Operators & tensor flow</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">APPNP iteration template / alpha=.1 / K=3 / no task head  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="55.0" y="1574" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f8d4e1" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="78.0" y="1587" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="78.0" dy="0">Inputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="240.0" y="1574" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c8ebfb" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="263.0" y="1587" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="263.0" dy="0">Propagation</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="448.0" dy="0">Parameters</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="610.0" y="1574" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#fff6bd" stroke="#263348" />

<tspan x="633.0" dy="0">Add / norm</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="795.0" y="1574" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="818.0" y="1587" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="818.0" dy="0">Tensor ops</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="980.0" y="1574" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9f1cd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1003.0" y="1587" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1003.0" dy="0">Gates</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="425.0" y="1604" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f3f5f7" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="448.0" y="1617" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="448.0" dy="0">Topology</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="610.0" y="1604" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="633.0" y="1617" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="633.0" dy="0">Output</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1645" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1719" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1749" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1774" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
